BRIGHTEST_FLAME.title: Quality Flame
DEBT.title: Debt
ENTHRALLED.title: Enthralled
ENTHRALLED.description: If this is in your hand, you must play it before other cards. Gain 10 Block. Eternal.
FOLLY.title: Folly
EZMB_ROOT.title: Rootblight I
EZMB_ROOT.description:
When played, remove this from your master deck.
If this is still in your deck after combat, it worsens to [gold]Rootblight II[/gold].
EZMB_DEEP_ROOT.title: Rootblight II
EZMB_DEEP_ROOT.description:
When played, remove this from your master deck, and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rootblight I[/gold] after combat.
If this is still in your deck after combat, it worsens to [gold]Rootblight III[/gold].
EZMB_ROOTBLIGHT_III.title: Rootblight III
EZMB_ROOTBLIGHT_III.description:
When played, remove this from your master deck, and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rootblight II[/gold] after combat.
If this is still in your deck after combat, it stays as [gold]Rootblight III[/gold] (the first time this occurs, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rootblight I[/gold] after combat). No Rootblight IV.
EZMB_ROOT_BUD.title: Blight Sprout
EZMB_ROOT_BUD.description:
[gold]Temporary[/gold]. At Turn [blue]3[/blue] or [blue]4[/blue], if not yet drawn, place this on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
If seen and not played, add a [gold]Rootblight I[/gold] after combat. If never seen, it withers. Otherwise, if never drawn, it withers away.
EZMB_MARGINAL_NOTE.title: Marginal Note
EZMB_MARGINAL_NOTE.description:
Draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
If this remains in your hand at turn end, it becomes [gold]Deep Thought[/gold].
EZMB_URDA_SEEDLING.title: Seedling
EZMB_URDA_SEEDBED.title: Seedbed
EZMB_URDA_SEEDBED.upgradeLine: Immediately plant up to [blue]{ImmediatePlantCount}[/blue] eligible cards from your draw or discard pile.
EZMB_URDA_SEEDBED.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose cards to plant. Planting removes them from this combat and gives Withered Husk; it does not trigger play, discard, or Exhaust. Sprouts add no Rootblight; Rootblight keeps its stage.
EZMB_URDA_RAIN_BREATH.title: Rain Breath
EZMB_WITHERED_HUSK.title: Withered Husk
EZMB_WITHERED_HUSK.description:
When exhausted, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
(Seedbed cannot plant this)
EZMB_VAKUU_KNIFE_CONTRACT.title: Knife Contract
EZMB_VAKUU_KNIFE_CONTRACT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to Vakuu and lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. If a [gold]Stolen Lock[/gold] remains, break [blue]1[/blue] and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Blood Debt[/gold].
EZMB_VAKUU_TEMPTATION.title: Gold Contract
EZMB_VAKUU_TEMPTATION.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. If a [gold]Stolen Lock[/gold] remains, break [blue]1[/blue] and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Blood Debt[/gold].
EZMB_VAKUU_SHELTER_CONTRACT.title: Avoid Debt
EZMB_VAKUU_TRICK_CONTRACT.title: Fraud Contract
EZMB_VAKUU_TRICK_CONTRACT.description: Break [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Stolen Lock[/gold]. Add {Debt:diff()} [gold]Blood Debt[/gold]. Vakuu's attacks deal {Backlash:diff()} more damage.
EZMB_VAKUU_CASH_OUT_CONTRACT.title: Cash Out
EZMB_VAKUU_CASH_OUT_CONTRACT.description:
End the Vakuu fight and take the loot from broken locks.
Only playable after breaking at least [blue]1[/blue] lock.
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_DRAW_PAGE.title: Draw Page
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_VEIL_PAGE.title: Veil Page
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_BURN_PAGE.title: Burn Page
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_DISCOUNT_PAGE.title: Discount Page
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_DISCOUNT_PAGE.descrip: [gold]Temporary[/gold]. The next card you play this turn costs [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_BRAVERY_PAGE.title: Bravery Page
EZMB_MORVI_ARCHIVE_DEXTERITY_PAGE.title: Dexterity Page
EZMB_MORVI_RED_INK_OVERDRAFT.title: Red Ink Overdraft
EZMB_MORVI_RED_INK_OVERDRAFT.description:
Can only be played at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
Draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and record [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI_WASTE_PAPER.title: Waste Paper
EZMB_MORVI_WASTE_PAPER.description: [gold]Temporary[/gold]. Paperstorm can consume this from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
EZMB_URDA_SEEDBED.immediateLine: Immediately plant up to [blue]{ImmediatePlantCount}[/blue] eligible cards from your draw or discard pile.
